items.description: Reasoning vision-language-action (VLA) models for autonomous driving use chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning to guide action generation, but incur substantial memory and computational costs. We study structured pruning for these models, focusing on preserving both scene understanding and trajectory prediction. items.title: Let Vision-Language Models Generate Images through Their Representations
items.description: Recent unified multimodal models aim to combine visual understanding and generation within a single model, yet effectively integrating the two capabilities remains challenging. items.title: TowerBridge: Bridging the Dual-Encoder Modality Gap via Weight-Space Programming
items.description: CLIP-style dual encoders map images and text through two separate towers into a shared embedding space, where the two modalities occupy distinct regions separated by a modality gap. items.title: Language Models Steer on Injected Uncertainty Tokens, but Fail to Self-Monitor In Situ
items.description: Prompting language models to verbalize stepwise numerical confidence during generation is an increasingly popular approach for triggering backtracking and error correction in agentic reasoning. items.title: How Far Can Linear Go? BiPert, a Unified Framework for Single-Cell Perturbation Modelling
items.description: Understanding how genetic perturbations affect cellular behaviour is essential for studying gene function and regulatory mechanisms. Large-scale CRISPR screens measure these effects across thousands of genes, but cover relatively few cellular contexts. items.title: Self-Supervised Dataset Distillation via Mutual Information Maximization
items.description: Dataset distillation (DD) aims to compress a large dataset into a small synthetic one that remains effective for training neural networks. Despite its success in supervised learning, DD remains underexplored in self-supervised learning (SSL), where distilled data must preserve the information needed to learn representations that remain consistent across augmentations. items.title: Agentic AI for Intent Management and Control in Autonomous Communication Networks
items.description: Artificial intelligence (AI)-driven automation will help future mobile networks translate high-level network intents into concrete network optimization or control actions. items.name: CTLink: A Text-Prompted Segmentation Model for Linking Radiology Report Findings to 3D Chest CT Scans
items.title: CTLink: A Text-Prompted Segmentation Model for Linking Radiology Report Findings to 3D Chest CT Scans
items.description: Radiology reports describe findings in text only, without visually marking them on the scan, so readers cannot directly see which abnormality each reported finding refers to. We introduce CTLink, a text-prompted 3D segmentation model that segments findings described in a chest CT report. items.title: LeJEPA Features Are Not Isotropic, and Should Not Be
items.description: The SIGReg term in LeJEPA regularizes features to have an isotropic Gaussian distribution. Our first result is to show that this regularizer, in practice, cannot achieve its goal. We design a modified regularizer to enforce the objective better. This leads to slightly improved performance. items.title: Seeking in Space: Benchmarking Purposeful Active Exploration of Vision-Language Models for Spatial Reasoning
items.description: Humans explore unfamiliar spaces with purpose, deciding where to look until they have gathered the evidence a spatial question requires. items.title: Flood forecasting using a physics-guided conditional denoising diffusion probabilistic model

items.name: Matching Under Metric Privacy
items.title: Matching Under Metric Privacy
items.description: We study how to represent and randomize points in $d$-dimensional Euclidean space to obtain accurate bipartite matchings under metric privacy. items.title: ToolSmith: An Automatic Tool-Generation Framework for Multimodal Search Agents
items.description: Recent multimodal search agents use reasoning, vision, and live web search across many turns to answer questions beyond parametric knowledge by orchestrating a small library of hand-crafted search and visual tools. items.title: Learning Neurovascular Codes for EEG-to-fMRI Synthesis
items.description: In this paper, we introduce Neurovascular Codes as shared EEG representations for fMRI generation. items.title: Know When to Abstain: Conformal Confidence Estimation for Text-to-SQL
items.description: Text-to-SQL systems often return queries that execute successfully but answer the wrong question. Detecting these errors at deployment is hard because execution correctness is defined against a gold query, which exists only in labeled data. items.title: CO-GRAFT: Attributing Reinforcement Learning Gains in Search Agents via Role-Level Policy Grafting
items.description: Reinforcement learning (RL) improves large language model search agents by up to 32 exact-match (EM) points over their pre-RL initializations, yet overall accuracy gains do not identify which underlying functional capabilities improve or interact during training. items.title: Needwise: Generation-Free Conversational Recommendation from Need-Level Typed Decisions
items.description: Conversational recommenders must rank items against needs that catalogs record only in part, while users add, withdraw and reverse needs and switch between requests. LLM rankers re-read the dialogue at every turn: they are slow, and their ordering does not show which needs an item meets. items.name: Reducing Order Sensitivity in Decision Models
items.title: Reducing Order Sensitivity in Decision Models
items.description: Decision models are emerging as fast components of larger AI systems. Yet recent decision models, such as Jev, process options sequentially, leading to different predictions based on their ordering. items.title: SPROUT: Predicting Objective-Grounded Prompt Utility for Efficient Text-to-Image Preference Tuning
items.description: Preference tuning of text-to-image diffusion models spends most of its compute generating candidate images, yet training prompts are typically sampled uniformly at random, wasting compute generating images that provide too little signal for model alignment. items.title: Analyzing and Improving FlowMap Distillation of Autoregressive Video Models
items.description: FlowMap distillation offers a natural route to few-step generative modeling by directly learning a teacher's denoising trajectories.
